Firmware Engineering Intern (Winter 2027)

The Role
You will write embedded C/C++ firmware for STM32 and other ARM microcontrollers running FreeRTOS, and bring up drivers for I2C, SPI, UART and CAN peripherals.

Responsibilities
- Develop and debug firmware on microcontrollers, using oscilloscopes and logic analyzers
- Implement communication protocols (UART, I2C, SPI, CAN bus)
- Build Python test automation for hardware-in-the-loop validation
- Work with control loops (PID) for motor control

Required Qualifications
- Proficiency in C and C++
- Experience with microcontrollers and embedded systems
- Understanding of interrupts, DMA and real-time constraints

Preferred
- Experience with RTOS (FreeRTOS, Zephyr)
- Familiarity with TinyML or edge ML is a plus
- Linux and Git experience
